body.name: Independent directional spectral object
body.construction: On \(L^2(\mathbb R^{S_c})\), define \[\mathcal Q_c(\psi)=\int_{\mathbb R^{S_c}}\{4|\partial_v\psi(\xi)|^2+V_c(\xi)|\psi(\xi)|^2\}\,d\xi\] on the form closure of compactly supported smooth functions, and take \(\inf_{\|\psi\|_2=1}\mathcal Q_c(\psi)\).
